cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.18)
project(mcx_background LANGUAGES CXX)
add_library(mcx_background SHARED src/mcx_api.cpp src/flowbench.cpp src/mist.cpp src/fusion_soft.cpp src/fusion_hard.cpp src/light_flow.cpp)
target_compile_features(mcx_background PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
target_compile_definitions(mcx_background PRIVATE FLOW_NO_IMAGE_IO)
set_target_properties(mcx_background PROPERTIES CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden VISIBILITY_INLINES_HIDDEN ON)
if(WIN32)
 set_target_properties(mcx_background PROPERTIES PREFIX "")
endif()
if(MSVC)
 target_compile_options(mcx_background PRIVATE /O2 /fp:strict)
else()
 target_compile_options(mcx_background PRIVATE -O3 -fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=off)
endif()
if(MINGW)
 target_link_options(mcx_background PRIVATE -static-libstdc++ -static-libgcc)
endif()
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
target_link_libraries(mcx_background PRIVATE Threads::Threads)
